_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic page, spare knowing ink line with soft watercolor in muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, Pacific Northwest coastal light, economy of line, quiet composition. an environment sheet for private late pages: a library back room with archive boxes, an empty chair and reading-room glass; a moss-grown carved stone face half sunk in grass beside a bench by a shingle wall; a yellow square street sign bearing a single eye on a pole with a fish weathervane above; a forested ridge east of a town with a faint glow on it; soft watercolor; labeled ROFLCOPTER SETS. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, saturated color, neon, anime, busy composition, watermark, extra fingers
